description: This file contains unit tests for JSON socket stream communication within the WPEFramework project, including class definitions for command parameters, command objects, a JSON connector template, and a test case that sets up a socket server and client to exchange JSON messages.

classes.name: Parameters
classes.description: Represents command parameters with speed, duration, command type, and settings, used in JSON communication.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: Represents a command object with identifier, name, base address, trick flag, and parameters, used in JSON communication.

classes.name: JSONObjectFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating JSON command objects, manages a pool of Command instances.

classes.name: JSONConnector
classes.description: A template class for JSON socket communication, handling sending, receiving, and state management of JSON messages over sockets.

methods.name: Parameters()
methods.description: Constructor initializing JSON container with speed, duration, command, and settings.

methods.name: Command()
methods.description: Constructor initializing command object with id, name, base address, trick flag, and parameters.

methods.name: Element(const string&)
methods.description: Returns a JSON element proxy for a command object.

methods.name: Received(Core::ProxyType<Core::JSON::IElement>&)
methods.description: Handles incoming JSON elements, storing data or submitting it for processing.

methods.name: Send(Core::ProxyType<Core::JSON::IElement>&)
methods.description: Placeholder for sending JSON elements over the socket.

methods.name: StateChange()
methods.description: Handles socket state changes, signals when the socket is open.

methods.name: IsIdle() const
methods.description: Indicates whether the connector is idle.

methods.name: GetState()
methods.description: Returns the static state indicating if the socket server is active.
